rationale: A clean, internally consistent within-firm reformulation of the "self-funded R&D" theme that is not a mechanical restatement of the prior cross-sectional versions, though it is simple and thematically adjacent enough (cf. Liability-Light R&D Persistence, Flexible-Financed R&D Exercise) that incremental information may be limited.

This is essentially the archived "Organic R&D Liability Coverage" signal — MA(xrd/at,3)/(lt/at) is proportional to a multi-year R&D sum over liabilities — with the same goodwill penalty attached, so it is a window/scaling variant rather than a substantively different construct.

The proposal reverse-engineers an economic story to match a prior wrong-signed result (liability growth × ad volatility), and the resulting triple rank product has no coherent reason for advertising *volatility* to be rewarded, making it a post-hoc fit rather than a mechanism.

Both legs are well-known published anomalies (share-issuance/composite-issuance and R&D-increase effects) and their rank difference is very likely dominated by the issuance leg, so this is close to a direct rediscovery packaged as an interaction.

The own-history double-high conditioning is a defensible way to avoid restating cross-sectional leverage and goodwill levels and is distinct from the archived rollover/goodwill high-watermark signal, though the mechanism is close to the known goodwill/asset-growth and leverage effects and the construction is minimal.

The product of two mean-centered SUB terms is high both when maturity is long with stable advertising *and* when short-term debt is paired with unstable/low advertising, so the expression does not isolate the hypothesized "patient financing plus stable brand" state and largely mirrors the archived Rollover Brand Funding Instability signal.
